title: Agent Brain export manifest signature
description: manifest.signature.json at the root of an Agent Brain PCP archive (PROV-8): an HMAC-SHA-256, under the exporting brain's per-brain signing key, over the SHA-256 of manifest.json. A verifier recomputes the manifest's SHA-256 and the HMAC before trusting anything the manifest says, so a manifest (or any listed file) altered after export is caught. Archive metadata like manifest.json itself: never listed in the manifest's files[].

alg.description: The signature algorithm. Only HMAC-SHA-256 is defined.

key_id.description: The signing key's id, so a verifier can tell which of the brain's keys (current or retired) signed. Not the key.

fingerprint.description: The first 16 hex characters of the key's SHA-256, for display and for telling two keys apart.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA-256 of the manifest's SHA-256 (its 64 lowercase hex characters) under the named key, with domain separation for the export-manifest purpose.
